hazards.control: Certified lifting gear; casing and tubing handling by trained crews.
Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Intermediate casing
function: The string set through formations that would otherwise cause trouble while drilling the production hole: lost circulation, salt, high pressure, or unstable shale.

tabs.overview: One or more intermediate strings depending on the well; cemented at least across the zones of concern.
tabs.safety: Wear from drilling the next section is checked before the frac.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
